title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I would like to know about a dream that I had once. It was when I was about 12 years old and it should have been after sunrise sometime. I saw myself in the night in the hospital giving birth to a son, then I remember loving the son greatly and keeping him with me. After this, I gave him to my father to look after and when I came back looking for him, he was lost and I just saw flashes of him here and there; then I started crying in the dream and woke up. I felt very strange after waking up and became attached to the idea of motherhood. I think I need the meaning of this dream, jazak Allahu khair. 1357 views Q. Few days before I dreamt that I am in a big orchard. I cross a small river 1266 views Q. I have a question regarding a dream I had. First I need to give you a background of the situation. I married a few months back and with the grace of Allah, my husband and I are trying to have a child. During last week, my mother has had dreams every night about babies and flowers and eating fruits and sweets. She tells me she thinks it is because I may be pregnant. Before I went to sleep one night after my mother told me this, I made dua to Allah to show me a sign in a dream whether I am pregnant or not and then I went to sleep. During that night, I had a dream that a lady doctor has come to my house and she is telling me that she can detect two pulse readings in my body, and she is telling me it is good news (that I am pregnant), in the dream I feel happy, and then I woke up. Please tell me what the meaning of this dream is, and if this relates to the dreams my mother is having almost every night about babies and me being pregnant. JazakAllah Khair. 1635 views Q. I had a dream last night.. which i could not remember very well.. but what i do remember was me seeing an elderley man wearing black clothing.. almost like a robe.. long beard, big bushy eyebrows and a long stick in his hands.. he was looking directly at me. I have been feeling very attched to Allah(swt) and the Prophet Muhammed(saw) alot lately, last night i was thinking about them and then i cried myself to sleep with their names in my heart and mind. Please let me know the reasons for these questions please. 1552 views Q. I would like to say may Allah Subhanahu Ta'alaa reward all the Ulema (espeacially the ifta department) that are working in this site. Alhamdulillah, I practice Islam, but fall short in many aspects and become heedless in sin sometimes frequently. I pray Allah give me Istiqamat (I say this not humbly but truthfully). I also attend the Weekly istema here and attend the khanqah of a shaykh very much connected to the Ulema of Deoband. I hope the information I provided is helpful in deriving an interpretation of a dream. The question is regarding a dream that I saw a few months ago. I live in Toronto, Canada and I got arrested by the police and then they took me in to prison. Upon arriving in my jail cell, I immediately realized there is no path now other then to to turn to Allah. I prayed and prayed on my Jainamaz within the jail cell and eventually got released. Can you tell me meaning of this? 1589 views Q. Is contact lens jaiz and what is the daleel? Who is Shaykh Yunis of India? 2685 views Q. azaan, hadees, naat, dua, quran ayat as caller tone 2822 views Q. I have seen in dream that i am reciting verse from surah nisa: wama kataluhu wama salabuhu..what is the taabir or my dream? 3107 views Q. Suggestion for joining a madarsa. 1811 views Q. My wife has been having dreams twice about getting married to different people and twice about getting proposal from a cousin and later she saw the cousin trying to show that she is her property 1766 views Q. My wife saw a dream and I would like the tabir of the dream, please. She saw our son M.Zahid (4 years old)inside a well and he is wearing a white topi. My wife goes in the well to save him and picks him with one hand, and the water in the well was dirty (matyala). Jazzak Allahu Kheir, remember us in your Dua's. 1395 views Q. Some scholars in pakistan are teaching that coming to the world of Hazrat Isa (AS) is not mentioned in Quran and anything not mentioned in Quran can not be our belief. kindly explain with detail. 1441 views Q. My father has fixed my marriage. I did istikhara and in 3-4 dreams I saw that he is interested in someone else or he has been married to someone else before 2593 views Q. Dreams 1389 views Q. In the present day there is a beloved person of Allah about whom Holy Prophet Hazrat Muhammad (PBUH) ordered in dreams of various people to immediately commence allegiance. Should they? 1377 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 29239 Country: NZ Title: DREAMS: Please interpret this dream for me. I am with my mum and mother's sister. I see 6 moons in front of me in the horizon. Each of these moons are arranged in such an order that they partially overlap one another, and these moons are full, with very bright outlines.One of the moons has the word Allah written on it in Arabic, while another moon has the word Eid Mubarak written on it in arabic. I dont know what was written on the other moons. When i see these moons, they appear big in appearance and very beautiful to look at.I ask my mothers sister to look at the moons, but she is not able to view it,,, and i think she may have been able to see it later. I am very happy in my dream when i see these moons. Question: DREAMS: Please interpret this dream for me. I am with my mum and mother's sister. I see 6 moons in front of me in the horizon.
